Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Dr. Anshuman
Oral Order
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.
2. The petitioner seeks regular bail in connection with Parsa P.S. Case No. 34 of 2023 registered on 12.02.2023 lodged under Sections 363, 366 and 376 of the I.P.C. and Section4/6 of POCSO Act.
3. As per the prosecution case, F.I.R. has been lodged against the present petitioner of kidnapping and subsequently committing rape of the victim.
4. Counsel for the petitioner submits that in the F.I.R. the specific allegation is that kidnapping is made with a view to marry.

Counsel submits that during investigation the alleged victim has been recovered and narrated her statement under Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.68132 of 2023(2)
dt.18-10-2023 Section 164 Cr.P.C. in-front of the Magistrate that she had not adversely alleged the petitioner.
The proof of marriage is annexed as Annexure-2.
Counsel submits that in the F.I.R., the age has been stated 18 years but in the certificate it is 17 years 11 months.
5. Counsel further submits that petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence.
He further submits that petitioner is in custody since 13.02.2023 having clean antecedent.
